name: Culm
author: E. T. Carter
description: A grove of round, cylinder-shaded bamboo canes in three depth-layered rows that recede and haze into the frame, each cane lit with a specular stripe and dark turning edges for real volume and divided by crisp swollen node rings. A calm, continuous wind travels through the grove as a smooth wave — the canes lean and breathe without ever freezing — while light runs steadily up each cane, a sparkle of node glints climbing joint by joint to the leafy tip.

params.label: Wind speed
params.effect: How fast the wind wave travels through the grove and how quickly the glints climb each cane.

params.label: Wind strength
params.effect: How far the canes lean and sway in the wind.

params.label: Cane spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between canes in the nearest row, from a dense reed bed to a sparse stand.

params.label: Crowding
params.effect: Density bias — higher packs more canes into the grove without changing their thickness.

params.label: Cane thickness
params.effect: Width of the canes, from slender reeds to fat bamboo.

params.label: Glint climb
params.effect: Brightness of the light-run that climbs joint by joint up each cane on wind crests.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Strength of the receding rows — far canes dim, thin and haze toward the sky (depth of field).

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: Cane-to-cane colour variation, from a single hue to the full palette spread.

params.label: Specular
params.effect: Intensity of the bright specular stripe down each rounded cane.

params.label: Leaf amount
params.effect: How many and how bright the leaf strokes are near the cane tops.

params.label: Ground mist
params.effect: Luminous haze pooling at the base of the grove.

params.label: Wind shimmer
params.effect: A subtle rippling shimmer along the canes as the wind passes.
